context: ELLE is available as 7.5 mg pink capsules printed with black edible ink with “BRISDELLE” and “7.5 mg” on the capsule. Each capsule contains 9.69 mg paroxetine mesylate equivalent to 7.5 mg paroxetine base. Capsules: 7.5 mg ( 3 )

2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dosage of BRISDELLE is 7.5 mg once daily, at bedtime ( 2.1 ) 2.1 Dosage Information The recommended dosage of BRISDELLE for the treatment of moderate to severe VMS is 7.
